en.headline: Centre for Food Safety suspends poultry imports from more areas in Korea and the…
en.dek: The centre acted after notifications of highly pathogenic avian influenza outbreaks in Jangheung-gun, Yeoju and Gelderland.
body: The Centre for Food Safety announced on Wednesday that it has instructed the trade to suspend the import of poultry meat and poultry products, including eggs, from additional areas in South Korea and the Netherlands with immediate effect.

The centre received a notification from the Korean Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs about highly pathogenic H5N9 avian influenza in Jangheung-gun of Jeollanam-do and H5N1 in Yeoju of Gyeonggi-do. The World Organisation for Animal Health also reported an H5N1 outbreak in Gelderland province of the Netherlands.

According to Census and Statistics Department figures, Hong Kong imported about 80 tonnes of chilled poultry meat and about 11.48 million poultry eggs from South Korea, and about 790 tonnes of chilled poultry meat from the Netherlands, in the first nine months of this year.
The centre has contacted the Korean and Dutch authorities and will continue to monitor reports from the World Organisation for Animal Health and take further action as needed.
Correction: the Korean area is Yeoju (驪州市), previously misstated.

zh.headline: 食安中心暫停進口韓國及荷蘭更多地區禽肉及禽蛋
zh.dek: 中心因應長興郡、驪州及海爾德蘭省爆發高致病性禽流感而採取行動。
body: 食物安全中心周三宣布，即時指示業界暫停從韓國及荷蘭更多地區進口禽肉及禽類產品，包括禽蛋。
中心接獲韓國農林畜產食品部通報，全南長興郡爆發高致病性H5N9禽流感，京畿道驪州市爆發H5N1。世界動物衞生組織亦通報荷蘭海爾德蘭省爆發H5N1。
根據政府統計處資料，本港今年首九個月從韓國進口約80公噸冷藏禽肉及約1148萬隻禽蛋，從荷蘭進口約790公噸冷藏禽肉。
中心已聯絡韓國及荷蘭當局，並會繼續密切留意世界動物衞生組織的消息，因應疫情發展採取適當行動。
更正：韓國地區為驪州市，先前誤植。
